change: Script source-function call overhead. (1) The binder records argumentsOwners (ordinary functions whose arguments object a syntactic `arguments` reference or direct eval can observe, attributed through arrows to the receiver owner); lowering omits instantiateScriptArguments elsewhere. (2) Bodies with no var/function/lexical declarations and no separate parameter environment reuse the parameter scope instead of instantiateFunctionBody with an empty plan (runtime also returns early). (3) Number fast paths in binaryObjectValueOperation/binaryValueOperation/updateObjectValue skip coercion and result records for Number operands.

benchmark.source: A3 5-case Script fixture (cluster-k-script-call-overhead-v1-evidence/benchmark-cases.json): 0 baseline, 1 top-level 900k calls, 2 strict class/arrow 200k, 3 3M local calls in a function, 4 inline 1M-iteration loop.
benchmark.method: Node-reference-checked fixture images built with TINT_BUILD_ONLY=1 (no debug symbols), each case a fresh LLDB-contained process (run-case.sh.txt), initial stop and exit 42 recorded; /usr/bin/time user seconds; alternating before/after order per round.
benchmark.loadNote: Host load 25-88 (external MTLCompilerService saturation, see load-events.md); absolute CPU seconds inflate under load, ratios are from same-round alternation.

profile.method: TINT_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=1 images, Apple sample of case 3 under LLDB, exclusive via attributeNativeSample and inclusive from the full main-thread call tree.
profile.before: instantiateScriptArguments 66.3% inclusive (createArgumentsObject 60.0%, allocateObject 38.2% incl. GC); binaryObjectValueOperation 7.6%; resolveBinding 3.2%.
profile.afterArguments: binaryObjectValueOperation 26.2% (primitiveValue 11.3%), getBindingReference 14.1%, resolveBinding 11.9%, createDeclarativeEnvironment 11.1% (LinkedMap storage + GC).

equivalence.result: 42,806 lowered Test262 sources (harness, language, built-ins): new lowering equals the old one after removing instantiateScriptArguments statements and replacing empty-plan instantiateFunctionBody calls with the parameter scope (node hashes ignored); 0 mismatches; 178,624 of 180,431 instantiations elided.

oracle.result: Independent AST walk: every ordinary function with an `arguments` identifier or eval call in its own scope keeps an instantiation; 1 flagged file (optional-chaining/eval-optional-call.js) is eval?.() = indirect eval, an oracle false positive; 91 conservative extras.

regression.found: The v1 freeze (exact span matching) dropped arguments objects for static generator/async (incl. private) class methods: native language/arguments-object prefix 321/460 with 70 failures, all in those shapes (arguments-object-v1-freeze-interrupted*.{jsonl,txt}; stopped in a compile phase with no inferior).
regression.fix: Owner match by closing offset (68c637fb), red-first static-method-red-v1.log.

beforeRecheck.note: Rechecked singly at load ~15-20 on the same before freeze: all 3 timed out again; the S11.6.1_A1 strict inferior received ~92% of a core (4:24 CPU in 4:47 wall, ~280 CPU s of the 300 s budget), i.e. real slowness of the base, not host starvation.

canonical9.outcome: Before 6/9 (3 genuine near-budget timeouts on the pre-change base), after 9/9 on a freeze with the same base plus this change. Outcomes are not identical: the change turns 3 timeouts into passes; no pass became a non-pass.
